recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. It resolves the applied FHIR-47935 request without duplicating the already-voted FHIR-45246 issue or undoing later ImagingSelection cleanup work; no separate FHIR-45246 audit commit is recommended from this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-47935 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core ImagingSelection issue for R6. It reported that the Applied FHIR-45246 wording correction had not actually been applied to the ImagingSelection resource content, and its voted resolution repeated the requested clarification for the first content paragraph: describe DICOM SR content-item and DICOM Segmentation segment-number specifics and remove the confusing linkage-to-Observation/ImagingStudy wording.
initial_application: FHIR-45246 was initially implemented by 0492baaa7d, which changed the top-level StructureDefinition description but not the active root element definition. PR 3319 listed FHIR-47935, but the Jira comments later noted that PR did not include the actual change. PR 3527 listed FHIR-47935 and commit d5ac86f739 touched the top-level description, but did not update the root element definition. Later FHIR-51645 work in a5eef8f1cf rewrote both the top-level description and root definition to the current concise wording, and subsequent FHIR-54810 work added DICOM to Study and Series; the combined branch still had both active description fields saying the selection allowed linkage to an Observation Resource.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ImagingSelection as an active resource, work-group artifact, and approved resource, so source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml is current build source. The current ImagingSelection introduction already describes selected DICOM segmentation segments, DICOM Structured Report content items, and Observation.derivedFrom relationships, so the remaining problem was the misleading conformance-source summary rather than the narrative scope section. The later FHIR-51645 and FHIR-54810 changes mean this reconciliation should preserve the newer single DICOM Study and Series and set-of-frames wording rather than mechanically restoring the older R5/R6 ballot sentence.
reconciliation: Updated the ImagingSelection StructureDefinition description and root element definition to remove the misleading 'linkage to an Observation Resource' phrase and name the specific selectable details: frames, image regions, DICOM Structured Report content items, and DICOM Segmentation segment numbers.
source_changes: source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml: updated StructureDefinition.description and the root ImagingSelection.definition summary wording.
